answer: Make income travel over credit lines, as in the original Ripple network. A newcomer is paid only through trust lines that established agents extend to it, each an IOU signed with the post-quantum falcon scheme; the extender eats the loss if that identity is later proven fake. A farm's earnings are then capped by the honest credit reaching it, its min-cut, not its head count. Illustrative: 200 clones behind three 50 POA lines share 150 POA an epoch, and each new ripple of clones thins the slice. Through that prism, every fake identity costs a relationship someone backs with money.
